attempts.summary: parseSessionLog/SESSION_FIELDS now keep terminal_reason, api_error_status, model_usage (aliased from the result's camelCase modelUsage) and permission_denials alongside session_id/total_cost_usd/num_turns/duration_ms; old logs without them still parse unchanged. sessionUpdate compares object/array fields by JSON.stringify so a re-parsed log never looks 'new' on every Stop fire. Added formatDenials

notes.text: From the #129 spike (2.1.251): a subagent's usage is written to ~/.claude/projects/<proj>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl, a sidecar the parent transcript does not include. usageFromTranscript (src/stats.js:651) reads only transcript_path, so subagent tokens are invisible to hkb stats today — the 'sidechain lines are counted' comment at src/stats.js:114 describes the older in-file format. This card should walk <session>/subagents/*.jsonl next to the transcript.

Follow-on from #165 (model/effort ladder): once model_usage is on the attempt row, hkb stats should add a by_model table beside by_profile — attempts, completed / protocol_violation / changes_requested rates, mean turns, cost — and, crossed with kb.paths (docs-only · one module · several modules), a per-shape line such as 'claude-sonnet-5: 9/9 docs cards completed, 3/7 multi-module'. That table is the evidence the ladder in #165 and the operator routine in #149 read; without it the ladder is a guess. Keep --json stable: stats.by_model[model] and stats.by_shape[shape][model].

residual_risk: Field names (terminal_reason, api_error_status, modelUsage, permission_denials) and their exact shapes were not verified against a live claude 2.1.251 binary (none was available in this sandbox, and running `claude` was blocked by the harness) — they were taken from the task's own description and pinned in a hand-built fixture; a real-world rename or shape difference on the actual CLI would need a follow-up fixture update.

cli.js is outside the task's declared kb.paths scope (src/model.js, src/dispatch.js, src/stats.js, test/) but the 'hkb show' output change required it; flagging in case that collides with a concurrently-dispatched card touching cli.js.
src/stats.js was left untouched — the comment-thread follow-on (by_model stats table) is explicitly scoped to a separate future task (#165/#149), not this one.

results.summary: parseSessionLog/SESSION_FIELDS now keep terminal_reason, api_error_status, model_usage (aliased from the result's camelCase modelUsage) and permission_denials alongside session_id/total_cost_usd/num_turns/duration_ms; old logs without them still parse unchanged. sessionUpdate compares object/array fields by JSON.stringify so a re-parsed log never looks 'new' on every Stop fire. Added formatDenials and authPauseReason (pure, in model.js). watchChild pauses a profile on api_error_status 401/429 from the result, falling back to the old log-tail regex only when there is no JSON result line at all. The tick backfills session/cost/terminal_reason from the log for pid-mode attempts written off as crashed/timed_out (same treatment a --bg attempt already gets via jobSessionUpdate). hkb show prints 'ended: <terminal_reason>' and 'denied: <tool> ×N'; --json carries the fields verbatim on the attempt row. Refreshed and re-stamped docs/wiki/architecture/overview.md (its session-identity section) and appended a docs/wiki/log.md entry; the other 12 pre-existing stale wiki pages predate this change (verified by diffing wiki-check output before/after). PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/220
